abstract: Research on adoption of new practices, technologies and systems in agriculture has generated thousands of publications over the past 70 years, covering uptake of agricultural practices spanning more than 100 years. This paper contains selected key lessons from the results of this enormous research effort, drawn from numerous reviews of the literature and shaped by personal experience. The lessons include that trialling is not adoption, that extension is not necessarily the key to increasing adoption, that each new farming practice has its own adoption story, and that adoption is often slower than practice advocates expect, typically taking multiple decades. The identified lessons are juxtaposed with a number of flawed assumptions and misconceptions commonly held by people working in agricultural agencies. A number of methodological weaknesses are still common in existing studies, including neglect or poor representation of key variables, compromising the potential for the research to generate real understanding of adoption. This also inhibits comparison of studies and the application of meta‐analyses. Suggestions are made on ways to add value to the existing research and improve the quality of future research, including the collection and curation of good‐quality adoption data sets, the development of a searchable database of adoption studies, and the creation of best‐practice guidelines for the conduct of adoption research.
abstract_zh: 过去70年间，关于农业新实践、新技术和新系统采纳的研究已产出数千篇文献，涵盖跨越百余年的农业实践应用历程。本文从大量文献综述中提炼关键经验，并结合个人研究实践，呈现这项庞大研究工作的核心启示。这些经验包括：试验不等于采纳；技术推广并非提升采纳率的关键；每项新型农业实践都有其独特的采纳路径；采纳速度往往慢于实践倡导者的预期，通常需要数十年时间。本文将这些经验与农业机构从业者普遍存在的若干错误假设和认知误区进行对比分析。现有研究仍普遍存在方法论缺陷，包括关键变量的忽视或表征不足，这不仅削弱了研究对采纳机制的真实理解，也阻碍了跨研究比较与元分析的应用。本文提出提升现有研究价值、改进未来研究质量的建议，包括建立高质量采纳数据集并持续维护、开发可检索的采纳研究数据库，以及制定采纳研究最佳实践指南。
title: Reflections on Adoption of New Agricultural Practices
title_zh: 关于采纳新农业实践的思考

abstract: Using a continuous‐time overlapping generations model with semi‐endogenous growth, this study analyzes the impact of population aging on income inequality. We characterize the stationary distributions of household income and wealth and examine how increases in life expectancy and declines in fertility rates affect these distributions. Numerical simulations indicate that longer life expectancy reduces inequality, whereas lower fertility rates increase it. We further explore the distributional effects of exogenous productivity growth under varying degrees of population aging.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用包含半内生增长的连续时间世代交叠模型，分析人口老龄化对收入不平等的影响。我们刻画了家庭收入与财富的稳态分布特征，并考察预期寿命延长和生育率下降如何影响这些分布。数值模拟表明，预期寿命延长会降低不平等程度，而生育率下降则会加剧不平等。我们进一步探讨了在不同人口老龄化程度下，外生生产率增长对收入分配的影响。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Population Aging and Income Inequality in a Semi‐Endogenous Growth Model
title_zh: 半内生增长模型中的人口老龄化与收入不平等

abstract: We examine the social and agent‐specific welfare effects of monetary and macroprudential policy in a four‐agent estimated macro‐economic model comprising “ banked simple households ,” “ underbanked simple households ,” “ firm owners ,” and “ bank owners .” Optimal capital requirement and loan loss provisions ratios improve all agent‐specific and social welfare, but imply smaller gains for simple households and firm owners that rely on credit. Countercyclical capital buffers support firm owners and bank owners with smaller gains for the two simple households, while countercyclical loan loss provisions improve social welfare only for specific shocks. Coordination between monetary and macroprudential policies yields higher social welfare than no coordination.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了货币政策和宏观审慎政策在包含“银行化简单家庭”、“非银行化简单家庭”、“企业主”和“银行所有者”四类主体的估计宏观经济模型中的社会及主体特定福利效应。最优资本充足率和贷款损失准备金比率能够改善所有主体特定福利及社会福利，但对依赖信贷的简单家庭和企业主而言，其福利改善幅度较小。逆周期资本缓冲有利于企业主和银行所有者，但对两类简单家庭的福利改善较小；而逆周期贷款损失准备金仅在特定冲击下才能提升社会福利。货币政策与宏观审慎政策之间的协调比不协调能带来更高的社会福利。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Monetary and Macroprudential Policy and Welfare in an Estimated Four‐Agent New Keynesian Model
title_zh: 估计四主体新凯恩斯模型中的货币与宏观审慎政策及福利

abstract: We build a two‐country currency union dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model with endogenous growth to assess the role of product market regulation (PMR) and labor market regulation (LMR) for growth and the adjustment to shocks. We show that with endogenous growth, there is no reason to expect real income convergence. Large shocks can lead to permanent changes of output and real exchange rates. Differences are exacerbated by different PMR and LMR. Less regulated economies have higher trend growth and recover faster from negative shocks. Results are consistent with higher inflation, lower employment, and disappointing total factor productivity (TFP) growth rates experienced in more regulated euro area members.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含内生增长的两国货币联盟动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，以评估产品市场监管（PMR）和劳动力市场监管（LMR）对经济增长及冲击调整的作用。研究表明，在内生增长条件下，实际收入趋同并无必然性。大规模冲击可能导致产出与实际汇率的永久性变化。不同的产品市场监管与劳动力市场监管会加剧这种差异。监管程度较低的经济体具有更高的趋势增长率，且能从负面冲击中更快恢复。这一结果与监管更严格的欧元区成员国所经历的高通胀、低就业以及令人失望的全要素生产率（TFP）增长率表现相一致。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Market Regulation, Cycles, and Growth Dynamics in a Monetary Union
title_zh: 货币联盟中的市场监管、周期与增长动态

abstract: This paper examines how import tariffs by a developed country (the North) and a developing country (the South) affect innovation and foreign direct investment (FDI) using a quality ladder model. We show that a Northern import tariff raises the relative wage of Northern labor, but impedes innovation and FDI. This may worsen Northern welfare. By contrast, a Southern import tariff raises the relative wage of Southern labor and promotes innovation and FDI. This can improve Southern welfare. These imply that the South has a stronger incentive than the North to impose an import tariff, which is consistent with actual observation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用质量阶梯模型，研究了发达国家（北方）与发展中国家（南方）的进口关税如何影响创新与外商直接投资（FDI）。研究表明，北方进口关税会提高北方劳动力的相对工资，但抑制创新与FDI，这可能损害北方福利。相比之下，南方进口关税会提高南方劳动力的相对工资，并促进创新与FDI，从而改善南方福利。这意味着南方比北方更有动机征收进口关税，这与实际观察结果一致。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Tariffs and Foreign Direct Investment in a Dynamic North–South Model
title_zh: 动态南北模型中的关税与外国直接投资

abstract: Fiscal fragility undermines a government's ability to honor its bank deposit insurance pledge and induces a positive correlation between sovereign default risk and financial (bank) default risk. We show that this positive relation is reversed if bank capital requirements in fiscally weak countries are allowed to adjust optimally. The resulting higher requirements buttress the banking system and support higher output and welfare relative to the case where macroprudential policy does not vary with the degree of fiscal stress. Fiscal tenuousness also exacerbates the effects of other risk shocks. Nonetheless, the economy's response can be mitigated if macroprudential policy is adjusted optimally.
abstract_zh: 财政脆弱性削弱了政府履行银行存款保险承诺的能力，并导致主权违约风险与金融（银行）违约风险之间呈现正相关关系。我们证明，若允许财政薄弱国家的银行资本要求进行最优调整，这种正相关关系将发生逆转。相较于宏观审慎政策不随财政压力程度变化的情形，由此产生的更高资本要求能够强化银行体系，并支撑更高的产出与福利水平。财政脆弱性还会加剧其他风险冲击的影响。然而，若对宏观审慎政策进行最优调整，经济对此类冲击的反应可得到缓解。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Fiscal Distress and Banking Performance: The Role of Macroprudential Regulation
title_zh: 财政困境与银行业绩：宏观审慎监管的作用

abstract: Banks lend more to banks that are similar to them. Using data from the German credit register and proprietary supervisory data on the quality of banks' loan portfolio, we show that a similar portfolio of the lending and borrowing bank helps to overcome information asymmetries in interbank markets. While interbank lenders generally do not adjust their lending to information on the counterparty's portfolio quality, banks with an exposure to similar industries and regions strongly react to this private information. Lending between similar banks is particularly important for borrowers with opaque loan portfolios, which do not obtain credit from dissimilar peers.
abstract_zh: 银行更倾向于向与自己相似的银行提供贷款。利用德国信贷登记数据以及关于银行贷款组合质量的专有监管数据，我们证明，贷款银行与借款银行相似的贷款组合有助于克服银行间市场中的信息不对称问题。尽管银行间贷款人通常不会根据对手方贷款组合质量的信息调整其贷款行为，但那些在相似行业和地区有风险敞口的银行会强烈响应这一私有信息。相似银行之间的贷款对于贷款组合不透明的借款人尤为重要，这些借款人无法从异质同行处获得信贷。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Banks of a Feather: The Informational Advantage of Being Alike
title_zh: 同质银行的信息优势

abstract: When the Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy, do the prices of riskier assets fall relative to safer assets? Or, do investors interpret policy tightening as a signal that economic fundamentals are stronger than they previously believed, thus leading riskier assets to outperform? We present evidence that the latter of these two forces empirically dominates within the U.S. corporate bond market. Following an unanticipated monetary policy tightening, riskier corporate bonds outperform safer corporate bonds, demonstrating the importance of an informational, or nonmonetary, component within monetary policy announcements.
abstract_zh: 当美联储收紧货币政策时，风险较高的资产价格相对于安全资产是下跌还是上涨？或者，投资者是否将政策收紧解读为经济基本面比此前预期更为强劲的信号，从而推动风险资产表现更优？我们提供的证据表明，在美国公司债券市场中，后一种力量在实证层面占据主导地位。在意外货币政策收紧后，风险较高的公司债券表现优于更安全的公司债券，这凸显了货币政策公告中信息成分（或非货币成分）的重要性。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Nonmonetary News in Fed Announcements: Evidence from the Corporate Bond Market
title_zh: 美联储公告中的非货币新闻：来自公司债券市场的证据

abstract: We propose a theory on information transparency of optimal financial contracts. Our model nests adverse selection and agency cost. There exists a unique perfect Bayesian equilibrium with novel features: First, three types of optimal contracts can arise endogenously, that is, equity, transparent debt, and opaque debt. The former two require firms to take on a costly verification technology while opaque debt does not. Second, the unique equilibrium is either pooling on opaque debt, or mixing with transparent and opaque financing. Third, firms with sufficiently high quality and intermediate levels of internal funds find it optimal to use a transparent contract.
abstract_zh: 我们提出关于最优金融合约信息透明度的理论。该模型嵌套了逆向选择与代理成本。存在一个具有新颖特征的唯一完美贝叶斯均衡：首先，三种类型的最优合约可内生产生，即股权、透明债务与不透明债务。前两者要求企业采用成本高昂的验证技术，而不透明债务则无需如此。其次，该唯一均衡要么是全部采用不透明债务的混同均衡，要么是透明融资与不透明融资混合的均衡。第三，具有足够高质量和中等内部资金水平的企业发现使用透明合约是最优选择。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Information Transparency of Firm Financing
title_zh: 企业融资信息透明度

abstract: We study market illiquidity in an economy subject to nonfundamental shocks. Asset trading occurs via decentralized bargaining. The model has multiple rational expectations equilibria; we associate certain Pareto‐inferior equilibria with liquidity crises. The government can improve welfare by acting as a “market‐maker of last resort” (MMLR), purchasing assets at above‐market prices. Several policies employed by the United States during the financial crisis are examples of MMLR. We consider “aggressive” and “conservative” MMLR policies. The aggressive policy supports the unique Pareto‐optimal equilibrium. The conservative policy, which embeds a “no‐bailout constraint,” only supports an inefficient equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在遭受非基本面冲击的经济体中的市场非流动性问题。资产交易通过分散化议价进行。该模型存在多重理性预期均衡；我们将某些帕累托劣等均衡与流动性危机相关联。政府可通过充当“最后做市商”（MMLR），以高于市场的价格购买资产来改善社会福利。美国在金融危机期间采取的若干政策即为MMLR的实例。我们考察了“激进型”与“保守型”两种MMLR政策。激进型政策支持唯一的帕累托最优均衡，而嵌入“不救助约束”的保守型政策仅能维持无效率的均衡。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Liquidity Crises and the Market‐Maker of Last Resort
title_zh: 流动性危机与最后做市商

abstract: Banks adjust loan spreads after observing natural disasters linked to climate change. We isolate this updating process by identifying loans to borrowers at risk of, but not directly affected by, such disasters. Loan spreads for these borrowers spike in both primary and secondary markets, while no such updating occurs for non–climate‐related disasters. Evidence suggests a heightened perceived credit risk, which nonetheless cannot fully explain the increase in rates. Taken altogether, increased spreads are explained primarily by salience bias, as they are short‐lived and amplified by media attention. This salience impacts financial decisions at bank‐dependent firms.
abstract_zh: 银行在观察到与气候变化相关的自然灾害后，会调整贷款利差。我们通过识别那些面临此类灾害风险但未直接受影响的借款人的贷款，来分离这一更新过程。这些借款人的贷款利差在一级市场和二级市场均出现飙升，而与气候无关的灾害则未引发此类调整。证据表明，感知信用风险有所上升，但这并不能完全解释利率的上涨。综合来看，利差上升主要由显著性偏差解释，因其持续时间短暂且受媒体关注放大。这种显著性偏差影响了依赖银行的企业的财务决策。
title: The Rising Tide Lifts Some Interest Rates: Climate Change, Natural Disasters, and Loan Pricing
title_zh: 潮涨推高部分利率：气候变化、自然灾害与贷款定价

abstract: Regional crop‐livestock integration can reduce dependence on external inputs and improve circularity, but its implementation requires coordination across heterogeneous farms and may generate uneven welfare losses due to technical, economic and behavioural factors, including social norms and peer effects. This study develops a landscape bio‐economic model that integrates heterogeneous farmer preferences, farm‐level constraints and social coordination via social norms and peer networks. Applied to a Dutch case study, the model identifies, from a social planner perspective, coordinated integration strategies that optimise feed and manure exchanges between arable and dairy farms. We show that optimising farm‐to‐farm integration can reduce total nitrogen import by up to 20% with limited losses of farmer welfare relative to the unconstrained welfare‐maximising solution. The model estimates farm‐specific willingness‐to‐accept imposed circularity targets, accounting for losses across economic and non‐economic utility attributes, including social norm conformity. Willingness‐to‐accept increases non‐linearly as nitrogen reduction targets become more stringent, with the burden initially borne mainly by sustainability‐oriented and dairy farms, while extending to arable and conventional farms only at very ambitious targets. We also find that stronger preferences for social norm conformity can ease trade‐offs between farmer welfare and circularity and are associated with greater reliance on local feed exchange and a reduced role for manure exchange, indicating that social influence is practice‐specific. These results motivate targeted and phased policy programmes combined with coordination incentives.
abstract_zh: 区域作物-畜牧一体化可减少对外部投入的依赖并提升循环性，但其实现需要协调异质性农场，并可能因技术、经济及行为因素（包括社会规范与同伴效应）导致福利损失不均。本研究构建了一个景观生物经济模型，该模型整合了异质性农户偏好、农场层面约束以及通过社会规范和同伴网络实现的社会协调。以荷兰案例为应用场景，该模型从社会规划者视角识别出协调一体化策略，优化种植农场与奶牛养殖场之间的饲料和粪肥交换。研究表明，相较于无约束的福利最大化方案，优化农场间一体化可使总氮输入减少高达20%，同时农户福利损失有限。模型估算了农场层面接受强制性循环目标所需的最低补偿意愿，涵盖经济与非经济效用属性（包括社会规范遵从性）的损失。随着氮减排目标趋严，最低补偿意愿呈非线性增长：初期负担主要由可持续导向型农场和奶牛养殖场承担，而种植农场和传统农场仅在极高目标下才被波及。研究还发现，对社会规范遵从性的更强偏好可缓解农户福利与循环性之间的权衡，并与本地饲料交换依赖度提升及粪肥交换作用减弱相关，表明社会影响具有实践特异性。这些结论为结合协调激励的定向分阶段政策方案提供了理论依据。
title: Planning Crop–Livestock Integration With Social Norms: A Bio‐Economic Model Balancing Circularity and Farmer Welfare
title_zh: 基于社会规范的种养结合规划：平衡循环性与农民福利的生物经济模型

abstract: This study presents an empirical investigation regarding the role of business dynamism (BD) in driving economic development. The results reveal that BD has an escape‐competition (positive) effect and the Schumpeterian (negative) effect on incumbent firms. Mechanism analysis indicates that market competition, innovation intensity, and knowledge spillover are the channels through which BD affects incumbent firms. Moreover, the impact of reallocation is heterogeneous among city's market entry barriers and enterprise type. A decomposition analysis demonstrates that the contribution of BD to incumbents' aggregate productivity growth exhibits a steady increase over time, and this decomposition result aligns with theoretical predictions.
abstract_zh: 本研究对商业活力（BD）在推动经济发展中的作用进行了实证分析。结果表明，商业活力对在位企业同时存在“逃离竞争”（正向）效应和熊彼特（负向）效应。机制分析表明，市场竞争、创新强度与知识溢出是商业活力影响在位企业的传导渠道。此外，资源再配置效应因城市市场进入壁垒和企业类型的不同而呈现异质性。分解分析显示，商业活力对在位企业全要素生产率增长的贡献随时间推移稳步提升，该分解结果与理论预测一致。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Business dynamism, reallocation, and growth: Evidence from China
title_zh: 商业活力、资源再配置与增长：来自中国的证据

abstract: This paper studies how progressive fiscal policy shapes monetary policy in a heterogeneous‐agent economy. Progressive labor taxation, though distortionary, can mitigate the inflation bias of monetary policy by redistributing income. I examine this commitment channel through the lens of political conflict. When agents vote on monetary and fiscal instruments, progressivity curbs inflation bias by creating distributional tensions: lower productivity agents support higher labor taxes to protect the value of money holdings and shift tax distortions toward higher productivity agents. Anticipating lower inflation, all agents ultimately prefer adopting a progressive fiscal system.
abstract_zh: 本文研究累进性财政政策如何在异质性主体经济中塑造货币政策。尽管累进劳动税具有扭曲效应，但可通过收入再分配缓解货币政策的通胀偏差。本文通过政治冲突视角考察这一承诺渠道。当经济主体对货币与财政工具进行投票时，累进税制通过制造分配性张力抑制通胀偏差：低生产率主体支持提高劳动税以保护货币持有价值，并将税收扭曲转嫁给高生产率主体。由于预期通胀水平降低，所有经济主体最终都倾向于采用累进性财政体系。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Fiscal Progressivity and the Time Consistency of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 财政累进性与货币政策的时间一致性

abstract: This paper shows that dollar appreciations reduce GDP, investment, and private credit in emerging market economies, and documents the relative contribution and dynamics of four transmission channels, finding that financial channels dominate trade channels. Higher dollar‐denominated credit generates persistent contractions, with GDP falling 0.3 and investment 0.5 percentage points in the medium term. Low monetary policy credibility amplifies the initial GDP contraction by 0.2–0.3 percentage points, but only in the short run. The traditional Mundell–Fleming trade channel is muted, as dominant currency pricing and global value chain integration weaken the link between exchange rates and trade flows.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，美元升值会降低新兴市场经济体的GDP、投资和私人信贷，并记录了四种传导渠道的相对贡献与动态变化，发现金融渠道主导了贸易渠道。以美元计价的信贷增加会引发持续性收缩，中期内GDP下降0.3个百分点，投资下降0.5个百分点。低货币政策可信度会使初始GDP收缩幅度扩大0.2-0.3个百分点，但仅限于短期。传统的蒙代尔-弗莱明贸易渠道作用减弱，因为主导货币定价与全球价值链整合削弱了汇率与贸易流动之间的关联。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: The Dollar and Emerging Market Economies: Channels and Impacts
title_zh: 美元与新兴市场经济体：传导渠道与影响

abstract: This paper constructs the first global dataset on inter-sectoral capital service expenditures. I use this data to disaggregate capital services and intermediate inputs in a dynamic multi-sector trade model. Steady state allocations and responses to shocks are determined by a capital-augmented global input-output matrix. Two properties of the measured network deliver larger long-run consumption gains from globalization than existing estimates, as well as larger gains in more capital-intensive countries. First, more trade-exposed sectors supply capital to more consumption-influential producers. Second, heterogeneity in the network reallocates sectoral expenditures towards producers with larger declines in capital rental prices. These reallocations raise capital incomes and lower consumption price indices.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了首个全球跨部门资本服务支出数据集。利用该数据，我在动态多部门贸易模型中对资本服务与中间投入进行了分解。稳态配置及对冲击的响应由资本增强型全球投入产出矩阵决定。相较于现有估算，该测算网络的两大特性表明：全球化带来的长期消费收益更大，且资本密集型国家的收益增幅更为显著。其一，贸易暴露度更高的部门向更具消费影响力的生产者提供资本；其二，网络异质性促使部门支出向资本租赁价格降幅更大的生产者重新配置。这种重新配置既提高了资本收入，又降低了消费价格指数。
title: Capital Services in Global Value Chains
title_zh: 全球价值链中的资本服务

abstract: We propose the concept of coherent shocks: externally identified shocks whose structural interpretation is independently validated within the empirical model. Using textual data, we classify articles by economic mechanism and construct mechanism-specific shock proxies. Our coherence criterion measures the posterior share of impulse-response draws matching the assigned signature, benchmarked against its prior share. Applied to geopolitical risk (GPR), we use a large language model to construct supply-type and demand-type GPR series. Shocks identified from both series are strongly coherent with their assigned signatures. Innovations in the overall GPR index blend the two, and neither recursive nor sign-restriction identification separates them. The criterion applies to any externally identified shock for which theory implies a response signature.
abstract_zh: 我们提出“一致性冲击”概念：指那些结构性解释在经验模型中得到独立验证的外部识别冲击。通过文本数据，我们按经济机制对文章进行分类，并构建特定机制的冲击代理变量。我们的一致性标准衡量了与指定特征匹配的脉冲响应后验占比，并以先验占比为基准进行校准。应用于地缘政治风险（GPR）时，我们利用大语言模型构建供给型与需求型GPR序列。从两个序列中识别的冲击均与其指定特征高度一致。整体GPR指数的创新混合了两种类型，且递归识别与符号约束识别均无法将其分离。该标准适用于任何理论隐含响应特征的外部识别冲击。
title: Coherent shocks: External identification and internal validation with an application to geopolitical risk
title_zh: DP21794 一致性冲击：外部识别与内部验证——以地缘政治风险为例

abstract: We analyze foreign exchange (FX) trading on FIFA World Cup game days in comparison to “normal” days. The FX market is an interesting case to study, as it has an institutional feature that allows participants to shift their trading needs to a counterparty bank so that the bank executes the trades at the London 4 p.m. fix. This “trade‐shifting” allows the client to avoid actively managing their trades and spend more time on World Cup‐related events. Using data from two different sources (EBS and CLS), we document this behavior and find that the effects are statistically and economically significant.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了国际足联世界杯比赛日与“正常”日的外汇交易行为。外汇市场是值得研究的有趣案例，因其制度特征允许参与者将交易需求转移至对手方银行，由该银行在伦敦下午4点定盘价时执行交易。这种“交易转移”机制使客户无需主动管理交易，从而将更多时间投入世界杯相关活动。基于两个不同数据源（EBS和CLS）的实证分析，我们记录了这一行为，并发现其影响在统计和经济意义上均具有显著性。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Foreign Exchange Trading During World Cup Events (or I will watch the game while you trade)

abstract: Firms introduce products in markets where they anticipate stronger demand, using information unobserved by researchers. This creates endogenous selection in demand estimation. In differentiated-product oligopolies, multidimensional demand unobservables and strategic entry can render the ordinary propensity score insufficient for selection correction. Existing approaches either restrict firms' information at entry or jointly estimate demand, pricing, and entry under strong supply-side assumptions. We derive a new mixture representation of the selection-bias function using latent propensity scores: entry probabilities conditional on observables and a latent market state generating dependence across entry decisions. This representation yields a convenient two-step semiparametric estimator that corrects for selection and price endogeneity while accommodating richer information at entry. The approach makes weaker supply-side assumptions and is simpler to implement because it avoids repeatedly solving the full model. Applied to the US airline industry, the method yields more elastic demand and less market power than estimates ignoring endogenous entry.
abstract_zh: 企业在预期需求更强的市场中推出产品，这一决策基于研究者无法观测的信息。这导致需求估计中存在内生选择问题。在差异化产品寡头市场中，多维度的需求不可观测因素与策略性进入行为，使得普通倾向得分不足以修正选择偏差。现有方法要么限制企业进入时的信息集，要么在强供给端假设下联合估计需求、定价与进入决策。我们利用潜在倾向得分推导出选择偏差函数的新混合表示形式：即基于可观测变量与一个生成跨进入决策依赖性的潜在市场状态的条件进入概率。该表示形式可构建便捷的两步半参数估计量，在修正选择偏差与价格内生性的同时，允许企业进入时拥有更丰富的信息。该方法对供给端假设要求更弱，且因无需反复求解完整模型而更易实施。应用于美国航空业时，相较于忽略内生进入的估计结果，该方法得出更具弹性的需求与更低的市场势力。
title: Identification and Estimation of Demand Models with Endogenous Product Entry and Exit

abstract: Using loan-level matched data between banks and firms from 2014 to 2022, we examine the association between banks’ adoption of artificial intelligence and shadow banking activities among non-financial firms. We find that bank-level AI adoption is associated with a significant and robust reduction in firms’ engagement in shadow banking. This mitigating effect operates through two channels. First, AI adoption enhances banks’ ex-ante screening capacity, improves borrower identification, expands credit access for high-quality firms, and alleviates financing constraints. Second, by strengthening post-lending monitoring, AI adoption is associated with a lower incidence of corporate financial misconduct and limits firms’ ability to divert loan proceeds into shadow banking activities. The governance effect is more pronounced among firms with greater information asymmetry and in regions with weaker financial regulation, and it is strongest for entrusted loans, a major form of corporate shadow banking in China. Further evidence shows that bank AI adoption is associated with reduced firms’ reliance on short-term borrowing and significantly higher investment in core business activities, suggesting that AI curbs financial arbitrage incentives and facilitates the reallocation of credit towards the real economy. This study provides novel bank–firm-level evidence on how digital financial intermediation reshapes corporate shadow banking behaviour. KEYWORDS: Bank AI adoption corporate shadow banking financial intermediary functions credit availability financial misconduct JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G28 G32
abstract_zh: 基于2014至2022年银行与企业层面的贷款匹配数据，本文考察了银行采用人工智能与非金融企业影子银行活动之间的关联。研究发现，银行层面的人工智能采用与企业影子银行参与度显著且稳健地降低相关。这一抑制作用通过两条渠道实现：其一，人工智能采用增强了银行的事前筛选能力，改善了借款人识别，扩大了优质企业的信贷获取渠道，并缓解了融资约束；其二，通过强化贷后监控，人工智能采用与企业财务违规行为发生率降低相关联，并限制了企业将贷款资金转移至影子银行活动的能力。这种治理效应在信息不对称程度较高的企业以及金融监管较弱的地区更为显著，且对委托贷款（中国公司影子银行的主要形式）的影响最为突出。进一步证据表明，银行人工智能采用与企业短期借款依赖度降低及核心业务投资显著增加相关，这表明人工智能抑制了金融套利动机，并促进了信贷向实体经济的重新配置。本研究为数字金融中介如何重塑企业影子银行行为提供了新颖的银行-企业层面证据。关键词：银行人工智能采用；企业影子银行；金融中介功能；信贷可得性；财务违规行为 JEL分类：G21 G28 G32

abstract: Accelerated depreciation policies allow firms to front-load depreciation allowances, generating a substantial intertemporal tax shield that reduces the cost of capital. Leveraging China’s 2014 accelerated depreciation policy for fixed assets as a quasi-natural experiment, this study employs a Difference-in-Differences (DID) method to examine its impact on corporate artificial intelligence (AI) adoption. Our results indicate that the tax incentive serves as a ‘stepping stone’, significantly promoting the uptake of AI technologies in pilot firms. This positive outcome primarily operates through two taxpayer-side mechanisms: alleviating financing constraints and upgrading human capital structures. Shifting the focus from taxpayers to tax administration, moderation analysis distinguishes between administrative services and administrative enforcement by revealing that policy effectiveness is strengthened by streamlined services rather than stringent enforcement. Heterogeneity analysis further demonstrates that the AI-promoting effect is more pronounced for large-scale or recession-stage firms, as well as those in low-uncertainty environments. Finally, we bridge the gap between tax incentives and market stability by showing that the tax incentive suppresses stock price crash risk, revealing its crucial role in fortifying firm resilience and mitigating financial risks. This study provides empirical evidence on how targeted tax incentives catalyse corporate AI adoption, offering policy implications for facilitating high-quality economic development. KEYWORDS: Accelerated depreciation policy for fixed assets corporate artificial intelligence adoption tax incentive financing constraints human capital structures JEL CLASSIFICATION: O33 O38 H25 H32
abstract_zh: 加速折旧政策允许企业提前计提折旧，形成跨期税盾，从而降低资本成本。本研究以中国2014年固定资产加速折旧政策为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID）考察其对企业人工智能（AI）采纳的影响。结果表明，税收激励作为“垫脚石”，显著促进了试点企业AI技术的应用。这一积极效应主要通过两条纳税人侧机制实现：缓解融资约束与升级人力资本结构。将视角从纳税人转向税收征管，调节效应分析区分了行政服务与行政执行，发现政策有效性通过简化服务而非严格执法得以增强。异质性分析进一步表明，大规模企业、衰退期企业以及处于低不确定性环境中的企业，其AI促进效应更为显著。最后，本研究通过揭示税收激励抑制股价崩盘风险，弥合了税收激励与市场稳定性之间的研究缺口，凸显其在增强企业韧性与化解金融风险中的关键作用。本研究为定向税收激励如何催化企业AI采纳提供了经验证据，并为推动经济高质量发展提供了政策启示。关键词：固定资产加速折旧政策；企业人工智能采纳；税收激励；融资约束；人力资本结构 JEL分类：O33 O38 H25 H32

title: Stepping stone or stumbling block: the impact of tax incentives on corporate artificial intelligence adoption
title_zh: 垫脚石还是绊脚石：税收激励对企业人工智能采纳的影响

abstract: Supply chain disruption is a critical operational risk, yet how ESG misconduct affects supply chain stability remains underexplored. Using a BERT-based measure of supply chain disruption risk constructed from MD&A disclosures of Chinese listed firms, we find that ESG incidents significantly elevate supply chain disruption risk. This effect operates primarily through the customer channel, while supplier relationships remain largely unaffected. This asymmetry is consistent with customers facing lower switching costs and being more sensitive to supplier reputation. Quantile regressions reveal that the effect is more pronounced among firms already facing elevated supply chain risk. Cross-sectionally, the effect is stronger for smaller firms, non-state-owned enterprises, heavy-pollution industries, and periods of economic downturns. Community-oriented, diversity-related, and product-oriented CSR activities buffer ESG-induced supply chain risk, whereas environmental management and employee relations efforts do not, indicating that externally visible CSR carries insurance value. The effect persists approximately one to two years and ultimately impairs operating performance. Our findings identify ESG incidents as an important yet manageable driver of supply chain instability and highlight the strategic value of proactive ESG management and targeted CSR investment in sustaining supply chain resilience. KEYWORDS: ESG incidents supply chain disruption risk corporate social responsibility reputational contagion JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 M14 L14
abstract_zh: 供应链中断是一种关键运营风险，但ESG不当行为如何影响供应链稳定性仍未被充分探讨。基于中国上市公司MD&A披露文本构建的BERT供应链中断风险度量指标，我们发现ESG事件显著提升了供应链中断风险。这一效应主要通过客户渠道传导，而供应商关系基本不受影响。这种非对称性与客户面临较低转换成本且对供应商声誉更为敏感的特征一致。分位数回归显示，在已面临较高供应链风险的企业中，该效应更为显著。横截面分析表明，该效应在规模较小企业、非国有企业、重污染行业以及经济下行时期更为突出。社区导向、多元化相关及产品导向的CSR活动能够缓冲ESG引发的供应链风险，而环境管理与员工关系举措则无此效果，这表明外部可见的CSR具有保险价值。该效应持续约一至两年，并最终损害经营绩效。我们的研究揭示了ESG事件是供应链不稳定性的重要但可管理驱动因素，并强调了主动ESG管理与针对性CSR投资在维持供应链韧性中的战略价值。关键词：ESG事件 供应链中断风险 企业社会责任 声誉传染 JEL分类：G32 M14 L14

title: The ripple effect of misconduct: ESG incidents and supply chain disruption risk
title_zh: 不当行为的涟漪效应：ESG事件与供应链中断风险

abstract: This study examines how enhanced local autonomy affects ecological quality by analysing China’s County Power Expansion reform, which granted unprecedented fiscal and administrative powers to county governments. Using a comprehensive ecological index that captures multiple environmental dimensions, we find that the reform is associated with a decline of 0.64 index points in local ecological quality. This deterioration is associated with a stronger prioritization of economic development, reflected in increased growth-oriented expenditure and business attraction, while environmental protection expenditure did not increase significantly. The negative ecological effects are amplified in counties facing stronger economic pressures but mitigated where environmental performance metrics are included in official evaluations. These findings reveal important trade-offs in decentralized environmental governance and highlight how institutional incentives can shape local governments’ environmental decisions. KEYWORDS: Environmental governance decentralization ecological quality local government behaviour county-power-expansion reform China JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q56 Q58 P25 H70 R50 Acknowledgements We thank the editor and two anonymous referees for their insightful feedback.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过分析中国“扩权强县”改革（该改革赋予县级政府前所未有的财政与行政权力），探讨地方自主权增强对生态质量的影响。基于涵盖多维度环境指标的综合生态指数，我们发现该改革导致地方生态质量下降0.64个指数点。这种退化与地方政府更侧重经济发展优先相关，具体表现为增长导向型支出和招商引资力度增强，而环境保护支出未显著增加。在面临较强经济压力的县域，生态负面效应被放大；但在官员考核纳入环境绩效指标的县域，该效应得到缓解。这些发现揭示了环境治理分权化中的重要权衡，并凸显制度激励如何塑造地方政府的环境决策。关键词：环境治理 分权化 生态质量 地方政府行为 扩权强县改革 中国 JEL分类：Q56 Q58 P25 H70 R50 致谢：感谢编辑及两位匿名审稿人的真知灼见。

abstract: I document declining trust in the Executive and Legislative branches of the US federal government from 1972 onwards. Data are from General Social Survey questions asking whether respondents “have a great deal”, “only some,” or “hardly any” confidence “in those running these institutions”. Net confidence (percentage difference between “great deal” and “hardly any”) in the two branches has declined continually from nearly zero in the early 1970s, accelerating substantially from the 1990s on. Different processes drive this decline for each branch. Partisan and ideological opponents of the President increasingly distrust the incumbent while supporters are roughly neutral. Trust in the US Congress has been eroding more uniformly across all parties and ideologies. In recent years net confidence has been around -30 for the Executive and -45 for Congress. This profound distrust (10 times as many have hardly any v a great deal of confidence in Congress) is widely shared across main socio-demographics, such as age, gender, income, etc., though the decline is steeper for older and white respondents. The decline is also greater than for other institutions, including until recently the third branch (Supreme Court). I close by discussing implications for research in public choice.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了自1972年以来美国联邦政府行政与立法部门公信力持续下降的趋势。数据来源于综合社会调查中关于受访者对"这些机构管理者"信任程度的问题，选项包括"非常信任"、"部分信任"和"几乎不信任"。两部门的净信任度（"非常信任"与"几乎不信任"的百分比差值）从20世纪70年代初接近零的水平持续下滑，自20世纪90年代起加速恶化。不同部门公信力下降的驱动机制存在差异：总统的党派与意识形态反对者对其不信任程度持续加深，而支持者基本保持中立；美国国会的公信力则在所有党派与意识形态群体中呈现更均匀的侵蚀态势。近年来，行政部门的净信任度约为-30，国会约为-45。这种深度不信任（对国会"几乎不信任"的受访者数量是"非常信任"的十倍）广泛存在于年龄、性别、收入等主要社会人口学群体中，但老年群体和白人受访者的下降幅度更为显著。与其他机构（包括近期之前的第三部门——最高法院）相比，其下降幅度也更为突出。本文最后探讨了该现象对公共选择研究的启示。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The long decline of trust in democratic institutions
title_zh: 民主制度信任的长期衰退

abstract: Subnational governments operating under the same federal fiscal arrangements often make markedly different tax policy choices. Research explains this variation through vertical relationships between subnational and national governments, horizontal relationships among subnational governments, or both, and along either economic or political logics. This study offers a unifying analytical framework integrating these dimensions and logics to help scholars locate their research within the wider literature, identify adjacent processes that may interact with or confound their focal mechanisms, and specify appropriate empirical strategies. I illustrate the framework’s value through analysis of Mexico’s state vehicle ownership tax (2008–2024). Situating the analysis within the framework yields three competing arguments about how horizontal economic and political logics interact. Spatio-temporal analysis shows that partisan competition, not geographic proximity, is the primary channel of horizontal tax policy interdependence. This partisan effect is conditional on neighbors’ tax activity, but in an unexpected way: it is strongest where neighboring states hold their taxes steady and weakest where they are cutting most heavily. The case demonstrates the framework’s usefulness in revealing new substantive findings and prompting new theoretical questions.
abstract_zh: 在相同联邦财政安排下运作的次国家级政府，往往制定出截然不同的税收政策选择。现有研究通过次国家级政府与中央政府间的纵向关系、次国家级政府间的横向关系，或两者兼而有之，并遵循经济或政治逻辑来解释这种差异。本研究提出一个整合这些维度与逻辑的统一分析框架，帮助学者在更广泛的文献中定位自身研究，识别可能与其核心机制相互作用或产生混淆的邻近过程，并制定适当的实证策略。通过分析墨西哥州级车辆所有权税（2008-2024年），本文展示了该框架的价值。将分析置于该框架内，可得出关于横向经济与政治逻辑如何相互作用的三个竞争性论点。时空分析表明，党派竞争（而非地理邻近性）是横向税收政策相互依存的主要渠道。这种党派效应取决于邻州的税收活动，但以出人意料的方式呈现：在邻州保持税率稳定的情况下效应最强，而在邻州大幅减税时效应最弱。该案例证明了该框架在揭示新实质性发现和引发新理论问题方面的实用性。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Beyond free riding or free racing: a framework for understanding subnational tax policy interdependence
title_zh: 超越搭便车或竞相逐底：理解次国家级税收政策相互依赖的框架

abstract: A classic exchange between Tullock (1973: 1256–1257.")) and Parks (1975: 225–226. https://doi.org/10.1086/260317 .")) debated whether universities should concentrate research support on senior or junior faculty. Both made their arguments informally. We formalise the two positions and then ask which conclusions survive when the scarce input is AI compute rather than secretarial help. Under complementary inputs, aggregate-output maximisation favours juniors, while minimum-output objectives favour seniors. With AI modelled as a more substitutable input, greater substitutability alone does not reverse the junior-favouring allocation when faculty differ only in career incentives. Only the perfect substitutes limit removes the junior advantage by making the department indifferent. Reversal requires that senior faculty also possess a human-capital advantage. Sufficiently high substitutability can then shift the allocation towards seniors. A two-period extension shows why the dynamic case for juniors depends on additional primitives such as longer career horizons or steeper AI learning curves. Two appendices establish that neither the two-researcher representation nor quadratic effort costs drives the central invariance result.
abstract_zh: Tullock（1973: 1256–1257）与Parks（1975: 225–226）之间的一场经典辩论，探讨了大学是否应将研究支持集中于资深教师或青年教师。双方均以非正式方式提出论点。我们将其两种立场形式化，并考察当稀缺投入从秘书协助转变为人工智能算力时，哪些结论依然成立。在互补性投入条件下，总产出最大化倾向于支持青年教师，而最低产出目标则倾向于资深教师。当人工智能被建模为更具替代性的投入时，若教师仅存在职业激励差异，则更高的替代性本身并不会逆转偏向青年教师的资源配置。只有在完全替代的极限情形下，部门才会因无差异而消除青年教师的优势。逆转需要资深教师同时拥有人力资本优势，此时足够高的替代性才能使资源配置向资深教师倾斜。两期扩展模型揭示了为何动态情形下支持青年教师的结论依赖于额外前提条件，例如更长的职业周期或更陡峭的人工智能学习曲线。两个附录证明，无论是双研究者表征还是二次努力成本，均不驱动核心不变性结果。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Allocating faculty compute budgets
title_zh: 分配教师计算预算

abstract: Why do fire sales occur if many risks are hedgeable? We study a version of Brunnermeier and Sannikov (2014, American Economic Review 104, 379–421) in which all fundamental risks can be hedged frictionlessly. Our analysis shows that fire sales are inherently self‐fulfilling. Fundamental shocks can never cause fire sales, and an efficient, safe equilibrium exists. On the other hand, there exists an equilibrium in which agents coordinate fire sales on nonfundamental shocks. A simple refinement based on vanishingly small perceived fundamental risk eliminates the safe equilibrium and selects the fire‐sale equilibrium as the unique outcome.
abstract_zh: 如果许多风险都是可对冲的，为何还会发生抛售潮？我们研究了Brunnermeier和Sannikov（2014，《美国经济评论》第104卷，第379–421页）的一个版本，其中所有基础性风险均可无摩擦对冲。分析表明，抛售潮本质上是自我实现的。基础性冲击永远不会引发抛售潮，且存在一个高效、安全的均衡。另一方面，存在一个均衡，其中经济主体在非基础性冲击上协调引发抛售潮。一个基于极小感知基础性风险的简单精炼方法消除了安全均衡，并将抛售潮均衡选为唯一结果。
title: Dynamic Self‐Fulfilling Fire Sales
title_zh: 动态自我实现的抛售潮

abstract: This paper analyzes the taxation of emissions in the presence of two institutional frictions common in developing countries. First, credit markets are underdeveloped in terms of both access to credit and borrowing conditions. Second, limited state capacity restricts the operation of the tax system. The analysis shows that the second-best emissions tax reflects both marginal environmental damages, as in the Pigouvian principle, and the effectiveness of taxation in reducing pollution. Credit market frictions hinder the adoption of clean technologies and increase emissions, which would, in isolation, call for a higher Pigouvian tax. However, these frictions may also reduce the responsiveness of emissions to taxation by limiting firms’ ability to adopt cleaner technologies, thereby lowering the optimal second-best tax. To capture these mechanisms, the paper distinguishes between two types of distortions: collateral-based, productivity-independent differences in access to credit, and cash-flow–based borrowing constraints. The optimal tax responds differently to each type of distortion.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了发展中国家普遍存在的两种制度性摩擦对排放征税的影响。其一，信贷市场在信贷获取渠道与借贷条件方面均存在欠发达特征；其二，有限的国家能力制约了税收体系的运行效能。研究表明，次优排放税既需遵循庇古原则反映边际环境损害，又需体现税收在减少污染方面的有效性。信贷市场摩擦会阻碍清洁技术采用并增加排放量，单就这一效应而言，本应要求更高的庇古税。然而，这些摩擦通过限制企业采用清洁技术的能力，可能同时削弱排放对税收的响应弹性，从而降低最优次优税率。为捕捉上述机制，本文区分了两种不同类型的扭曲：基于抵押品且与生产率无关的信贷获取差异，以及基于现金流约束的借贷限制。最优税率对这两种扭曲的响应方式存在显著差异。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Revisiting Pigouvian Taxes Under Credit Constraints and State Capacity Limitations
title_zh: 信贷约束与国家能力限制下的庇古税再探讨

abstract: This paper examines the interaction between labor-market institutions and commodity tax-base design in an open economy with imperfect competition. We develop a two-country Cournot model in which a domestic firm bargains over wages with a monopoly labor union, while the foreign firm operates under a competitive labor market. Governments choose commodity tax rates under either the destination or the origin principle. We show that the welfare effects of unionization are systematically tax-base dependent. Under the destination principle, consumption-based taxation does not correct the production distortion induced by union wage bargaining, placing the unionized country at a disadvantage. Under the origin principle, production-based taxation directly interacts with union-induced cost distortions, yielding regime-specific welfare outcomes that depend on trade costs and the competitive wage. The analysis highlights tax-base design as a key institutional margin shaping strategic interaction and welfare in unionized oligopolies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在不完全竞争的开放经济中，劳动力市场制度与商品税基设计之间的相互作用。我们构建了一个两国古诺模型，其中国内企业与垄断工会进行工资谈判，而外国企业则在竞争性劳动力市场下运营。各国政府在目的地原则或原产地原则下选择商品税率。研究表明，工会化的福利效应系统性地依赖于税基设计。在目的地原则下，基于消费的税收无法纠正工会工资谈判导致的生产扭曲，使工会化国家处于不利地位。在原产地原则下，基于生产的税收直接与工会引发的成本扭曲相互作用，产生取决于贸易成本和竞争性工资的特定制度福利结果。分析凸显了税基设计作为影响工会化寡头垄断中战略互动与福利的关键制度维度。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为一般性两国模型，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Unionized oligopoly and tax principles
title_zh: 工会化寡头垄断与税收原则

title: Scarred by nature: How early exposure to natural disasters shapes risk attitudes
title_zh: 被自然所伤：早期自然灾害经历如何塑造风险态度

abstract: Governments increasingly look to capital income for both revenue and redistribution. This column compares two dividend tax reforms in Israel – a permanent rate increase and a temporary one-year cut – to examine how high-income taxpayers can adjust the timing and labelling of dividends in ways that undermine reform. Both produced immediate surges of more than 100% in reported dividends and tax revenue. But only the temporary reform left a lasting mark: payouts fell sharply once the relief expired, as firms retained earnings in anticipation of future cuts. Because undistributed profits are not recorded as personal income, the resulting rise in retained earnings also made top-income inequality appear to fall.
abstract_zh: 各国政府日益依赖资本收入来增加财政收入和实现再分配。本文比较了以色列两项股息税改革——一项是永久性税率上调，另一项是临时性一年期减税——以考察高收入纳税人如何通过调整股息申报时间和分类来削弱改革效果。两项改革均导致申报股息和税收收入立即激增超过100%。但只有临时性改革留下了持久影响：当税收优惠到期后，股息支付大幅下降，因为企业为预期中的未来减税而留存收益。由于未分配利润不计入个人收入，由此产生的留存收益增加也使得顶层收入不平等程度看似有所下降。
title: Dividend tax reforms: Why design shapes revenue and measured inequality
title_zh: 股息税改革：为何设计影响财政收入与测度不平等

abstract: Poverty is not a static condition but a dynamic process. Yet the at-risk-of-poverty rate, which underpins EU poverty monitoring, captures who is poor in a given year but says nothing about how long people have been poor. This column introduces complementary measures to assess dynamic poverty in the EU, which suggest that poverty is more widespread and persistent than annual rates alone suggest and experiences vary sharply across countries. Social protection systems differ markedly in their ability to reduce long-duration poverty. These findings have direct relevance for the EU’s newly adopted Anti-Poverty Strategy.
abstract_zh: 贫困并非一种静态状况，而是一个动态过程。然而，作为欧盟贫困监测核心指标的贫困风险率，仅能反映特定年份的贫困人口状况，却无法揭示贫困持续的时间。本文引入补充性指标以评估欧盟动态贫困状况，结果表明：贫困现象比年度数据所呈现的更为普遍且持久，且各国经历差异显著。不同社会保障体系在减少长期贫困方面的能力存在明显差异。这些发现对欧盟新近通过的《反贫困战略》具有直接参考价值。
authors: Alina Șandor, Shaun Da Costa, Argyrios K. Pisiotis
title: Beyond the snapshot: How poverty really unfolds over time in the EU
title_zh: 超越快照：欧盟贫困如何随时间真实演变
